en.title: Reported and evidential forms
en.summary: Reported forms tell what is said or believed without naming the speaker.

paragraphs: Reported forms tell what someone said, or what is believed, without saying who said it.

items: **It is said** that she is a doctor.

paragraphs: English uses a passive with say, believe, think and report: He is said to be happy. Words such as apparently and reportedly show that the speaker is not sure.

blocks.html:
FormExample
it + passiveIt is reported that prices will rise.
subject + passive + toHe is said to be ill.
